    Implements the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) for the Helium Hydride cation (HeH+)

    The Hamiltonian incorporates heteronuclear asymmetry (He vs H) evidenced by the

    circuit capable of capturing the ground state of this 2-electron system.

    pauli_labels = ["II", "IZ", "ZI", "ZZ", "XX", "YY"]
